artemis-launchpad: Run the ARTEMIS Android agent from any directory: resolves its Python 3.12+ venv and checks the planner's Gemini/Google API key before run or batch, with distinct exit codes for setup failures.
causa: Interactive causal-graph analysis tool (FastAPI + SQLModel + Typer) whose LLM calls go through the Hermes api-router.
coaching-make-bundle: Build and verify the kcv-web v0.3 corporate transfer bundle: one HTML file plus its papers, zipped into port/dist only if the artefact passes verification.
invoice-fetcher: Fetch invoice and receipt attachments from Gmail or IMAP into an organized local folder (patched local build of visnia-ai/invoice-fetcher).
nk: Check German Nebenkosten (service charge) statements: PDF to drafts, reconcile and repair cells, freeze, then write findings.json and tenant or landlord reports in HTML and PDF.
oc: Turn websites into a compact CLI so AI agents can open, read and act on pages without the token cost of raw HTML.
pdf-tools-redact: Remove given words from a PDF's text layer through the local Stirling PDF backend (pdf-tools redact); exits 7 if any word stays extractable.
pdf-tools-safe: Bundle several PDFs into one with an embedded manifest and unbundle them back losslessly; the same pdf-tools binary also splits, compresses and converts PDFs through the local Stirling backend.
prefab: Export a Prefab UI app (file.py:app) to a standalone HTML page; also serves it and runs a playground.
